  • Prior relevant internship or professional experience in site/civil design, including site planning, grading, stormwater management, drainage, and soil erosion;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical, multitasking, and judgment capabilities;
  • Ability to effectively work independently and in a team environment; and
  • Availability to work Monday through Friday with occasional evenings and weekends.

Langan provides a rich array of programs and benefits to help its employees advance their careers and enhance the quality of their lives. Our comprehensive compensation package includes: full-time employment company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage; life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, and paid pregnancy disability leave; 401(k)/Roth with company match; paid time off including parental and military leave; employee referral and professional license bonuses; and educational reimbursement.

Langan offers employee resource groups; flexible work schedules; extensive training; wellness programs; buddy and mentoring programs; and much more!

Langan is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We believe that an inclusive workplace is essential for the well-being and success of our employees.

title: Operador de Caixa
description:
Operador de caixa

Qual será a sua missão?

Operar o caixa/PDV, registrando cuidadosamente e corretamente as compras, preservando os produtos, mantendo a qualidade e garantindo bom atendimento e satisfação dos clientes.

Quais são as principais responsabilidades

  1. Realizar atendimento ao cliente de forma empática e diferenciada;
  2. Organizar o caixa/PDV, proporcionando agilidade no atendimento, bem como realizar todas as atividades inerentes à função;
  3. Identificar diariamente os produtos disponíveis para venda e oferecer ao cliente adequadamente;
  4. Zelar pela segurança e bom uso dos equipamentos, manter o ambiente de trabalho e instrumentos limpos e organizados, cuidar da higiene pessoal e do uniforme, de acordo com a legislação e normas vigentes.

O perfil que buscamos em você!

  • Comunicação clara e empática com o cliente;
  • Relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Organização;
  • Orientação para o cliente;
  • Comprometimento com o resultado.

O que precisa ter?

Ensino médio completo.

Quais são os benefícios?

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Refeitório;
  • Cesta básica;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Convênio farmácia;
  • Programa de treinamentos;
  • Trilha de carreira;
  • Descontos em cursos e universidades parceiras.

Todas as nossas oportunidades também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

Adicionais benefícios: alimentação no local, plano de saúde, seguro de vida, convênio farmácia.

Sobre a empresa

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil. Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras, ajudando-os a ter uma vida mais saudável.

Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas em 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG). Nossas lojas atendem cerca de meio milhão de clientes por mês, com operações omnichannel, incluindo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces, entregando em até três horas em regiões atendidas. Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos mensalmente, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas.

Nossa missão é promover uma vida mais natural, tornando-nos referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil. Nossos valores incluem jogo aberto, foco em resultados com qualidade, trabalho em equipe, excelência no atendimento, um jeito simples e alegre de ser, e atitude responsável.

Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, promovendo ambientes seguros, acolhedores, criativos e inclusivos. Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, bem como para todas as raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais.

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Sales Operations Analysts to join a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be a leader who shows initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions.
The role entails

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Review opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Manager to improve sales data quality and processes
  • Report on data quality metrics to executive level stakeholders
  • Implement surveys and define metrics for executive level stakeholders
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Lead automation and streamline the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience in a sales operations/sales order processing role
  • Experience in a technology subscription-based business
  • Experience driving data quality improvement
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to manage across boundaries and communicate effectively, particularly working with Sales, Legal, Finance and Marketing teams
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Position Overview: The Strategic Growth Partner is responsible for overseeing the complete sales and recruitment lifecycle with the client, ensuring efficient client management from lead to onboarding. This role focuses on taking initial discovery calls, understanding client job description needs, delivering service, maintaining organized workflows, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve client satisfaction and operational excellence.

About Us: Virtustant is a rapidly growing global staffing solutions provider dedicated to matching exceptional professionals with companies across various industries. Our mission is to connect businesses with the right talent to drive success and innovation. With a focus on quality, reliability, and efficiency, we strive to exceed the expectations of both our clients and candidates.

Key Responsibilities

Client-Focused Responsibilities:

  1. Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients during the sales and recruitment process, ensuring clear communication and timely updates.
  2. Being knowledgeable on pricing, job descriptions, and long-term planning to build strong relationships with the client.
  3. Conduct structured follow-ups at key milestones (e.g., after Discovery Calls, during recruitment phases) to ensure client satisfaction and alignment.
  4. Gather and analyze client feedback regarding the recruitment process and provide actionable insights.
  5. Manage client expectations and address concerns promptly during the recruitment phase.

Candidate-Focused Responsibilities:

  1. Develop a comprehensive initial job description that provides clear guidelines and expectations for the recruitment team. This description should outline the key responsibilities, qualifications, and skills required for the role, ensuring that it serves as a reliable foundation for the recruitment efforts.
  2. Help vetting and shortlisting candidates for client review.
  3. Organize and facilitate candidate interviews, ensuring client readiness through detailed instructions and guidelines.

Operational Responsibilities:

  1. Collaborate with Recruitment and HR teams to ensure timely and efficient delivery of services, including handoffs for new roles or clients.
  2. Maintain comprehensive records of client interactions, feedback, and performance metrics for continuous improvement.
  3. Be a part of Ruling Meetings with recruiters to evaluate candidate viability and finalize shortlists.
  4. Oversee and streamline the contract and payment processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  5. Facilitate the transition of clients to HR Consultants for ongoing role management once hiring is complete.
  6. Propose and implement process improvements, including automation and documentation updates.

Recurring Tasks:

Client-Facing Tasks

  1. Schedule and conduct follow-ups post-Discovery Call.
  2. Facilitate hiring processes, including sending General Contract and Payment documentation, providing onboarding recommendations, and ensuring smooth transitions.
  3. Handle new hiring processes, ensuring a smooth process as needed.

Internal Operational Tasks:

  1. Collaborate on the creation and refinement of processes, automation, and internal documentation.
  2. Support cross-departmental initiatives by sharing information, managing exceptional cases, and contributing to training materials.
  3. Develop and maintain organizational policies and internal guides.
  4. Conduct regular check-ins with recruiters to address day-to-day topics and ensure alignment.

Qualifications and Skills:

  1. Proven experience in sales, or client relationship management.
  2. Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities.
  3. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  4. Proficiency in CRM systems, scheduling tools, and communication platforms.
  5. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
  6. Analytical mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and results.

Language Requirement:

  1. C2 Level of English Proficiency.

Reporting and Collaboration:

  1. Reports to the Sales Manager.
  2. Collaborates closely with recruiters, HR Consultants, and marketing teams.
  3. Serves as a liaison between clients and internal teams to ensure seamless communication and process execution.
  4. Conduct annual reviews to reflect on performance metrics and plan for future needs.

Performance Metrics:

  1. Number of leads successfully converted to clients.
  2. Timeliness and accuracy in the recruitment process and offboarding activities.
  3. Client satisfaction during the process and after onboarding.
  4. Successful placement rates and feedback from clients.

  2. Commission structure available on top of base salary.
  3. 100% remote position

  5. 6 paid holidays (3 fixed and 3 flexible)

title: UX Designer
description:
Join to apply for the UX Designer role at VML .

At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey, offering deep insights in communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.

Who We Are Looking For

The UX Designer will work directly with external clients, understanding their needs and providing user-centered design solutions that enhance digital experiences. The candidate must be proficient in Figma, Sketch, or similar design tools and should have experience in user research, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing. They must be able to maintain fluent conversations in English and possess a Bachelor's degree in fields related to UX/UI Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a similar discipline.

What You'll Do

  1. UX Design:
    • User research: interviews, surveys, usability testing
    • Creation and tracking of wireframes, prototypes, and experience maps
    • Analysis of user flows and experience optimization
    • Definition of interaction strategies and intuitive navigation
  2. UI Design:
    • Visual design of attractive interfaces, focusing on aesthetics and functionality
    • Creation of scalable and consistent design systems
    • Knowledge of component creation and usage
    • Use of design tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, etc.
    • Development of interactive and high-fidelity prototypes
    • Knowledge in building brand guidelines (UI kits)

What You'll Need

  • Advanced English (must)
  • Proven experience in UX design
  • Academic background in UX/UI
  • Design tools: Figma (must), Sketch, Illustrator, Photoshop, Adobe XD, InVision, Zeplin, Miro
  • Communication skills: Presenting and defending design proposals to stakeholders

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

VML is a WPP Agency. For more information, please visit our website, and follow VML on our social channels via Instagram, LinkedIn, and X.

Summary

Assists the radiologist in various radiology procedures by prepping patients beforehand through explaining the process to them, checking their vital signs, administering medicine, and providing care for patients undergoing imaging procedures. Provides nursing services, helps to carry out physician orders, responds and reports to attending/radiologist any changes in condition, oversees the distribution of medications, charts medications, distributes/counts narcotics, and responds to emergencies.


Job Duties
  • Assesses patients prior to their procedures by studying patient medical histories, reviewing patient history and Lab values, and speaking with both patients and their physicians.
  • Administers conscious sedation per hospital policy.
  • Helps patients better understand the procedures they need and serves as a liaison between the patient, nursing staff, and physician. Attends to the needs of the patient while in Radiology. Provides proper patient care, comfort, and understanding at all times.
  • Communicates with RN or patient's physician any change in status, medications given, and any intervention taken, including transportation of patient back to unit if indicated. Initiates post procedure orders and communicates all pertinent data to the nursing unit and accompanies patient to unit, if indicated.
  • Discharges patient from interventional per Aldrette score/Anesthesia guidelines.
  • Inputs all LDA lines in EPic. Documents that a implanted supply has been exported in patients chart in EPic.
  • Responds to all code blues and RRT within Radiology. Assists radiologists and code teams as needed.
  • Collaborates with Pediatric Intensivist for sedation of Pediatric cases. Follows PALS guidelines.
  • Performs pre and post procedure telephone calls for outpatients.
  • Follows National Patient Safety Goals including complete Invasive Procedure Checklist and patient identification. Completes patient safety reports, as indicated.
  • Serves as a clinical resource for the nursing staff, patients, and healthcare providers.
  • Maintains equipment and room cleanliness. Puts unused supplies away and restocks as needed. Assumes responsibility for cleanliness and sanitation of the immediate work area. Does light housekeeping. Maintains orderliness.
  • Provides radiation protection in accordance with prescribed safety standards. Assumes responsibility and accountability for his/her own safety and the safety of others.
  • Assists in the education and training of new employees, students, and other ancillary personnel.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Associate's Degree Nursing
  • 3 years Experience in medical/surgical nursing and
  • 1 year Critical care
  • Ability to obtain and interpret information in terms of the patients needs that are age appropriate.
  • Ability to select proper instrumentation/supplies appropriate for age group of patient served.
  • Ability to administer moderate sedation, dysrhythmia recognition, and treatment.
  • Able to work under stressful situations.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support – State of Pennsylvania within 90 Days
  • ACLS – Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support – State of Pennsylvania within 90 Days
  • PALS – Pediatric Advanced Life Support – State of Pennsylvania within 90 Days
  • RN – Licensed Registered Nurse—PA – State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire

Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree Nursing

Physical Demands

Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Senior Staff Android Software Engineer (Poatek - Brazil applicants)
description:
Tech Lead (Android)

São Paulo-SP, Brazil or Porto Alegre-RS, Brazil

Who We Are

In 2021, Poatek was acquired by WillowTree, an award-winning digital product consultancy recognized as one of the fastest growing and best places to work in the United States. Now a TELUS International company , with offices across the globe, we continue to partner with the world’s leading brands, such as the NBA, Capital One, HBO, PepsiCo, Domino’s and more, to design, build, and transform their digital products and strategies. We’re looking to grow our Poatek offices in Brazil with top talent excited to collaborate with team members across the globe to deliver innovative solutions for our clients.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role, which we’ve termed Work from Near (WFN). This model requires the ability to work on-site from our São Paulo - SP or Porto - RS office throughout the week based on team needs, while still providing the flexibility to work remotely on other days. Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

As a Tech Lead (Android), you will be at the forefront of our dynamic team, leading the design of applications, tools, and processes while ensuring value, clarity, and maintainability. Your role will involve expertly navigating and enhancing client tech stacks, executing large-scale refactors, and advocating for world-class engineering practices. You will be instrumental in driving teams to reduce change fail percentages, resolving conflicts, advocating for new practices, and tailoring your communication to diverse scenarios. Furthermore, you are expected to tackle psychological safety impediments and mentor team members, fostering a conducive work environment across the entire build cycle.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the team and client in designing applications, tools, and processes, optimizing for value, clarity, and maintainability.
  • Plan and drive execution of large-scale refactors across the software ecosystem, managing dependencies and minimizing risk.
  • Use your strong understanding of the Android development lifecycle and ecosystem to help the team navigate non-trivial testing scenarios, such as video streaming, Bluetooth, and other peripherals, poor network conditions, etc.
  • Champion the adoption and implementation of new practices for project teams and clients, while using IDE’s, version control like Git, and command line tools effectively.

Additional Responsibilities

On-Call Support: This role includes periodic on-call duties to support our critical systems. Aligned with our commitment to work-life balance, we maintain a strict 10-hour daily work limit, even during on-call periods. Team members may be required to respond to issues outside of regular business hours on a rotational basis. Compensation for on-call duty is provided in accordance with Brazilian labor laws.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience (10+ years) as an Android Engineer, with a track record of leading complex projects.
  • Expert knowledge in implementing world-class engineering practices.
  • Deep understanding of client tech stacks and the ability to integrate and improve them over a series of projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan and execute large-scale refactors across the software ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of the Android development Lifecycle and ecosystem including languages, frameworks, and libraries (Java, Kotlin, Room, Coroutines/Flow, RxJava, Dagger 2, Gradle, Fragments, OkHttp3, Retrofit or Volley).
  • Comfort with IDE’s, version control systems such as Git, and command-line tools.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure, GitHub Actions) and experience setting up deployment pipelines.
  • Experience in frequently using frameworks such as Espresso, JUnit, Mockito/Mockk to write automated tests for your code.
  • Proven ability to recognize symptoms of various impediments to psychological safety and provide effective support.

Bonus Points

  • Expertise in choosing and executing deployment strategies that minimize risk and maximize client ROI.
  • Deep understanding and empathy for client hesitations around frequent releases, with proven strategies on how to overcome those hurdles.
  • Proven ability to balance helping and teaching with the need to finish things.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across a team to identify the level of support each team member needs in implementing different features.

Why Poatek?

What We Offer:

  • Be part of an innovative consultancy with a human-centered and culture with opportunities for ownership and professional growth
  • Competitive salary and benefits package (annual bonus)
  • Opportunity to work on innovative agile projects with other high-performing, passionate team members from all over the globe (international travel opportunities)
  • Collaborative work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development (including English classes, support in national and international courses,
  • Flexible work hours and autonomy
  • Voucher for health activities, food allowance, in-office snacks, drinks, and games

If you love IT as much as we do, we look forward to meeting you!

Equality is a principle here at Poatek. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing those information with us.

Oportunidade para apoiar no gerenciamento de reclamações de clientes, desde o registro até o encerramento, analisando soluções propostas e sugerindo melhorias. Apoiará na atualização dos controles internos, realizar follow-up com áreas envolvidas e manter os clientes informados.
Sua função:

  • Participar de todo o fluxo de gerenciamento de uma reclamação, desde o registro até a investigação e encerramento.
  • Analisar criticamente a solução apresentada para a queixa do cliente e avaliar/sugerir adaptações/novas abordagens para o owner.

Você é a pessoa certa se:

  • Possuir previsão de conclusão do curso a partir de Dezembro/2026;
  • Possuir Inglês básico e Excel Intermediário;

Como trabalhamos juntos
Acreditamos que geramos um impacto maior quando estamos juntos do que separados. Para nossos membros da equipe do escritório, isso significa trabalhar de modo presencial ao menos três dias da semana, para colaborar e estabelecer ligações com os outros.
Os cargos presenciais requerem a presença do colaborador o tempo inteiro nas instalações da empresa. Para os colaboradores que ocupam um cargo na área de campo, suas funções são desempenhadas de maneira mais eficaz fora das instalações da empresa, geralmente em instalações de clientes ou fornecedores.
Esta função se trata de uma posição no escritório.
Sobre a Philips

Pensando nisso, em parceria com o Instituto Primeira Geração (PriG) — organização que apoia pessoas que são a primeira geração de suas famílias a concluir o ensino superior — temos o orgulho de lançar o Programa Primeira Geração- Michelin 2025.

Voltado para pessoas recém-formadas no ensino superior, o programa oferece uma oportunidade única de desenvolvimento profissional, unindo a vivência prática de um estágio de pós-graduação na Michelin com um MBA prático, que será cursado ao longo do programa, relacionado à sua área de formação. Além disso, você contará com uma rede de apoio e aprendizado contínuo para impulsionar sua trajetória profissional.

Gostou? Então venha fazer parte da Michelin/PriG!

Quer conhecer mais sobre a Michelin? Seguem os canais:

Site : michelin.com.br/

Instagram : @michelinbrasil

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/michelin/


Main responsibilities

A área de P&D de Pneus para Ônibus e Caminhões é responsável por desenvolver soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis que atendam às necessidades dos clientes, com foco em segurança, performance e durabilidade. Nosso desafio é criar produtos que gerem valor para o cliente e para a empresa, contribuindo para sua competitividade e saúde econômica.

Com forte interface com as áreas de Marketing e Industrial, atuamos de forma colaborativa e global, em constante troca com times de desenvolvimento de outros continentes, buscando alinhamento e sinergia nas soluções técnicas.

E você desenvolverá as seguintes atividades:

  • Apoiar a equipe de desenvolvimento de produtos em todas as etapas dos projetos, contribuindo com atividades técnicas e operacionais;
  • Auxiliar na realização de simulações por elementos finitos (FEA), colaborando na análise estrutural e no estudo do comportamento dos pneus em diferentes condições de uso, com foco na otimização da performance e durabilidade;
  • Contribuir com a análise de produtos existentes no mercado, por meio de investigações técnicas sobre o desempenho e as características dos pneus já lançados;
  • Apoiar nas análises técnicas para identificação de causas relacionadas a problemas de desempenho, colaborando com sugestões de melhorias e ajustes no design;
  • Dar suporte na elaboração de relatórios e recomendações técnicas, com base nas análises realizadas, visando subsidiar a tomada de decisão com foco em performance, segurança e eficiência;
  • Colaborar com atividades transversais junto a outras áreas envolvidas no desenvolvimento de produtos, promovendo a integração e o alinhamento dos projetos;
  • Auxiliar na gestão de iniciativas relacionadas à excelência operacional, acompanhando o andamento das atividades e contribuindo para o cumprimento de prazos, processos e metas da equipe.

Position Summary:

Bentley Systems is seeking a talented individual to become a valued member of the Product Support team as aTechnical Support Engineer. As part of the Global Technical Support team, the technical support engineer is responsible for providing technical assistance on the product via (inbound/outbound) phone, e-mail, and web portal.This is a hands-on position that will interface with our users as well as our development, professional services, and sales departments. The position is responsible for problem analysis, documentation, resolution, and escalation involving Bentley’s supported products

We will rely on you for the following:

  • Provide troubleshooting and technical assistance for ProjectWise Product functionality/features to users via e-mail, service tickets, phone, and web-portal (BE Communities.
  • Assist with all facets of Bentley users and technical support by helping to identify user issues by isolating and resolving the issue or by proper escalation.
  • Advise and educate users on accurate usage of the Product and address specific use cases reported on the Service Requests.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a liaison between users and Product Management/Development.
  • Research and identify solutions to ProjectWise Product functionality/features.
  • Ask users targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
  • Maintain accurate notes and details on user support requests.
  • Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams (e.g., software developers).
  • Communicate with team members regarding current/ongoing issues via daily scrum calls.
  • Document software problem defects for review and take corrective actions.
  • Document technical knowledge in the form of Knowledgebase Articles or Communities Posts.
  • Meet with internal Bentley teams to provide the users’ perspective on our products and services.

Your daily tasks will look like this:

  • Review individual Support Case Backlog and prioritize Aged and Escalated Requests.
  • Reproduce issues in-house on test systems (Virtual Machines) to isolate the cause of the problem.
  • Monitor the Team Support Cases Queue and pick issues in the order of priority, impact, and age of the Service Request.
  • Update and follow-up with users over the phone/email on existing Requests.
  • Engage on Team Scrum calls to discuss issues and liaison with the team
  • Adhere to Phone Queue Schedule and ensure phones are always manned and voicemails processed.
  • Contribute to Bentley Communities and answer user queries.
  • Update the Team Technical Knowledge Base and share updates with the team.
  • Upskill on Product Knowledge by focusing on a new topic every week. Consume Training through internal Pathways, Wikis, videos, etc.
  • Channelize potential Defects/Enhancements to the Product Management/Development teams.
  • Provide a handover to the next shift with appropriate documentation when needed

What You Bring to The Team:

  • 2+ years of experience in technical support and exposure to global user interaction.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Experience or Knowledge with ProjectWise product suites or similar document management systems such as Documentum, Vault or Aconex.
  • Experience with the Administration of Engineering Information/Document Management systems.
  • Experience or knowledge with relational databases: Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle.
  • Experience or knowledge with Networking (DNS, TCP\IP, FQDN, cluster environments).
  • Experience or knowledge with Windows Operating System (Server and client) for administration and debugging.
  • A "user first" approach and strong critical thinking, with a desire to solve problems with excellent troubleshooting skills.
  • Emotional intelligence when talking with users, and the ability to document methodically.
  • Exposure to answering queries via Service Requests and Communities forum posts.
  • Ability to work well with Global colleagues to help address user issues.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by delegating, prioritizing, and scheduling tasks to ensure they are completed in the expected timelines.
  • A motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and in a team.

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience with ProjectWise infrastructure.
  • Knowledge or experience of IIS (Internet Information Services),
  • Proven success in all aspects of ProjectWise Administration.
  • Experience with MicroStation, AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, IPLOT (Printing\Plotting).
  • Knowledge with extended ProjectWise features (Publishing such as ICS for PDF, BAS; Bentley cloud features such as Deliverables Management, ProjectWise Drive, ProjectWise Projects, WSG, etc.)
  • An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction.
  • Competitive Salary and benefits.
  • The opportunity to work within a global and diverse international team.
  • A supportive and collaborative environment.
  • Colleague Recognition Awards.

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. SOBRE A MOTTU
Nós da Mottu acreditamos no poder de transformar vidas através da mobilidade e da inovação. Fundada em 2020, somos hoje a maior empresa de aluguel de motos do mundo, com mais de 100.000 motos em circulação e presença em mais de 100 filiais no Brasil e no México. Em setembro de 2023, concluímos nossa rodada Series C de US$ 50 milhões, liderada por grandes nomes do Venture Capital, como Crankstart Foundation, Bicycle Capital e QED Investors.
Somos a startup que mais cresce na América Latina e estamos no caminho para atingir o status de unicórnio ainda em 2025. Acreditamos em um mundo conectado e simplificado, com soluções tecnológicas que melhoram vidas. Valorizamos a superação, a igualdade e a união para construir juntos e transformar a forma como pensamos e agimos. Nós somos Mottu.
Nossos princípios inspiram cada passo da nossa trajetória e guiam nossas ações. Acreditamos no medo de ser mediano e, por isso, não nos conformamos com nada menos do que o excepcional: pensar grande e pensar pequeno dá o mesmo trabalho, então damos cada dia 10% a mais do que conseguimos dar no anterior, sempre buscando a grandeza e a escalabilidade. Nosso Foco no Cliente é inegociável, pois nascemos para dar oportunidade a quem nunca teve uma e somos obstinados em ajudá-los a conquistar seus sonhos. Mantemos a Cabeça de Dono, tomando decisões com coragem, autonomia e responsabilidade para deixar um legado com paixão e “sangue nos olhos”. Com Mão na Graxa, arregaçamos as mangas e fazemos nós mesmos para entender e melhorar cada processo, respeitando sempre a opinião de quem está na ponta da lança. E atuamos Ombro a Ombro, apoiando-nos mutuamente, cultivando relações genuínas, sinceras e duradouras, com a coragem de falar a verdade — afinal, aqui não há espaço para jogar em primeira pessoa.
Se você busca crescimento acelerado, desafios constantes e deseja fazer parte da nossa missão de revolucionar a mobilidade, a Mottu é o lugar certo para você! Venha somar ao time e construir conosco o futuro da mobilidade na América Latina.

title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst
description:
The Credit Risk Squad is part of the 2nd line of Defense, responsible for managing and overseeing the credit risk function of our organization by providing independent oversight and challenge to the first line of defense. As a second line Credit Risk team, we are responsible for creating Expected Credit Losses (ECL) models that are used to calculate loss allowances, making sure the company’s credit risk is managed correctly and efficiently, participating end-to-end in the model development process, including, implementation,monitoring, ensuring operational quality of the data and supporting Finance accounting teams.

About the Role:

As a Senior Credit Risk Analyst within our Credit Risk Squad (part of the 2nd Line of Defense), you will play a crucial role in overseeing and challenging the first line of defense in managing credit risk. Your primary focus will be on analyzing the health and performance of our credit portfolio, particularly within the retail market portfolios, including credit cards and personal loans. You will contribute significantly to ensuring the company’s credit risk is managed effectively, with a strong emphasis on the universe of credit provisions.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Analyzing and monitoring risk parameter models (PD, LGD, EAD) relevant to our retail portfolios, ensuring they align with regulations like IFRS9. While not necessarily developing these models, you will be instrumental in measuring their performance through activities such as backtesting to assess their quality.
  • Performing in-depth analysis of credit risk exposure and its implications for expected credit losses (ECL) and loss allowances. This will involve understanding how changes in the credit portfolio impact our provisions.
  • Participating in monthly accounting closing activities, contributing to the creation of reports on loss allowance movements.
  • Actively contributing to the enhancement of our controls environment within credit risk management. This is crucial for ensuring compliance with regulations such as SOX.
  • Liaising with Internal and External Audit teams during model validation processes, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and SOX compliance in our operational processes.
  • Maintaining a strong understanding of relevant local and international regulations concerning provisions and credit risk management, including a surface-level understanding of standards like Bacen 4966 and IFRS9.
  • Leveraging your analytical and problem-solving skills to manipulate and learn from data related to the credit portfolio.
  • This role requires a strong analytical background, a keen understanding of credit risk principles, and the ability to contribute to a robust and compliant credit risk management framework. Your work will directly impact the accuracy of our financial reporting and the overall stability of our credit operations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Math, Statistics, Physics or related fields
  • Analytical, problem solving and passionate to manipulate data in order to learn from it
  • Great coding skills (SQL, Python, Scala or other similar programming languages)
  • Knowledge and experience in local and international regulations regarding provisions and credit risk management
  • Adaptability to dynamic way of working/short term deliverables

Preferred qualifications

  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • Experience with SOX controls within risk management environment
  • Experience in developing or analyzing outputs of Expected Credit Loss models/PD/EAD/LGD

Sobre o cliente:

Nosso cliente é um escritório de advocacia fundando em 1941, meses antes da instalação da justiça do trabalho no Brasil. Sua sócia fundadora, Nilza Peres de Resende, foi a primeira mulher a fazer uso da tribuna do Supremo Tribunal Federal como oradora.

O escritório possui unidades em São Paulo e Rio de Janeiro, sendo referência nacional em Direito Empresarial Trabalhista e tem como missão assessorar empresas nas áreas de Direito do Trabalho e Previdência Social.

O que buscamos:

Pessoa advogada júnior, para atuar na área do Direito Trabalhista com polo passivo, em clientes de segmentos diversos, tais como: bancário, indústria, comércio, hospitalar, educação e outros.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar defesas, visando eliminar/minimizar o impacto financeiro que a reclamação trabalhista venha a acarretar ao cliente.
  • Realizar audiências trabalhistas.
  • Entrar em contato com as testemunhas, através dos canais de comunicação preestabelecidos, para orientá-las em relação a localidade e hora da audiência.
  • Entrar em contato com os prepostos, através dos canais de comunicação preestabelecidos, visando buscar informações para contribuir com a defesa do cliente, bem como para orientá-los em relação a localidade e hora da audiência.
  • Entrar em contato com o cliente para sanar eventuais dúvidas, assessorar, responder questionamentos e/ou solicitar proposta de acordo, através dos canais de comunicação preestabelecidos, com o intuito de atendê-lo da melhor maneira possível.
  • Elaborar e enviar os relatórios solicitados pelo cliente, através dos canais de comunicação preestabelecidos com o objetivo de manter o cliente atualizado.
  • Realizar acompanhamento processual, através do sistema jurídico interno, tribunais e presencialmente, com o objetivo de atingir o êxito.

Sistema jurídico: Projuris

O que é necessário:

  • Graduação em Direito com carteira da OAB ativa (0-3 anos).
  • Experiência em escritório de advocacia com contencioso na área trabalhista.
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Direito Processual Trabalhista e Direito do Trabalho.

Skills esperados:

  • Profissional interessado em aprendizado e desenvolvimento.
  • Direito processual e material trabalhista.
  • Boa capacidade analítica para elaborar relatórios e pareceres ao cliente.
  • Postura proativa e dinâmica para lidar com muitas informações.
  • Atenção e foco para lidar com dados sensíveis e prazos.

O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

description:
Business Systems Technical Analyst, CLM Administrator

The Company You’ll Join

Carta develops purpose-built software that transforms traditional accounting into a powerful growth engine. Carta’s world-class fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under management in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more. Together, Carta is setting a new standard as the end-to-end platform for private markets.


The Problems You’ll Solve

As a CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) Admin, You’ll Work To:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Legal, Sales, Finance, Procurement, IT, etc.) to gather and document requirements for CLM enhancements
  • Analyze business needs to define functional and technical specifications for system updates
  • Ensure alignment between contract workflows, approvals, and compliance requirements
  • Configure and manage CLM workflows, approval processes, contract templates, data mapping, clauses, redlining, and automation
  • Oversee the implementation of new features and enhancements within the CLM platform
  • Support CLM system integrations with Salesforce and other tools
  • Develop and execute unit test cases for CLM enhancements to ensure functionality meets business needs
  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders and resolve issues before deployment
  • Manage CLM deployment to production, ensuring version control of contract templates and minimal business disruption
  • Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot issues, and collect feedback for continuous improvements
  • Act as a point of contact for CLM-related queries, ensuring smooth contract execution
  • Continuously improve contract workflows to enhance efficiency and reduce turnaround times

The Team You'll Work With

You’ll be joining our Business Systems Team , which is responsible for building, managing, and optimizing technology across every aspect of product sales and operational support at Carta. Our mission is to drive growth by developing the platform, infrastructure, and tools that keep the company running efficiently.


About You

  • 3+ years of experience working with contract lifecycle management tools collaborating with deal desk, legal operations, or sales operations teams
  • Experience with Conga CLM or similar CLM solutions
  • Knowledge of contract template setup, data field mapping between CLM platforms and integrated systems, clause libraries, and version control for document automation
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including advanced formatting, styles, and automation features
  • Basic knowledge of Salesforce Admin and SOQL (Salesforce Object Query Language)
  • Strong understanding of contract structures, clauses, redlining, and approval processes
  • Experience collaborating with legal, sales, finance, deal desk, and procurement teams to align contract processes
  • Excellent teamwork skills with a positive attitude
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle, and prioritize multiple requests simultaneously
  • Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills

Preferred But Not Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Legal Studies, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with DocuSign, Adobe Sign, Conga Sign, and their integration with CLM platforms
  • Proficiency with tools like Conga Composer for automated document generation

Disclosures

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate.
  • Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization.
  • Interested in data privacy? Check out our policies on Privacy and CA Candidate Privacy.
  • Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com or @carta-external.com domain.

title: Analista fiscal
description:
Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, incluindo equipamentos para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Com dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, a empresa investe 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento.

Em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a alemã Putzmeister, formando o maior líder mundial em equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a presença do Grupo Sany começou em 2007, inicialmente como importador, consolidando-se em 2011 com investimentos de US$ 200 milhões e a inauguração de uma unidade de montagem em São José dos Campos. Em 2012, recebeu a certificação ISO 9001:2008. A partir de 2013, passou a montar guindastes RT e rolos compactadores na mesma unidade. Em 2017, inaugurou instalações em Jacareí/SP. A rede de distribuidores e filiais garante atendimento em todo o país.

Requisitos para se candidatar:

  • Formação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;

Empresa Diversa:
Estamos em todo o Brasil e na Colômbia, reunindo pessoas de diferentes culturas, estilos de vida, gênero, opção sexual, religião, ideologia e outras singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Abraçamos, acolhemos, aceitamos e incluímos todas as pessoas, sem olhar para rótulos. Acreditamos que a pluralidade é essencial para troca de experiências e desenvolvimento coletivo.
